message:
I’ve always prided myself on being the gloriously over-prepared person in my family. It brings me such peace of mind knowing that I have a few handy skills tucked away, just in case. I recently came across a fantastic resource that offers practical tips for safety skills, which is just perfect for those little emergencies that life throws our way. 

Being prepared doesn’t mean being anxious; it’s more about feeling grounded and ready for anything. What’s one skill you’ve wanted to learn to feel a bit more ready for the unexpected?
